utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twentieth. Can you hear me? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Bit tinny. More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Actual cake, not those sad cereal bars.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Lovely. I'm already thinking about weekend plans and the weather's looking rubbish. Walking boots or just the pub, that's the decision.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: It's Tuesday, mate. Ambitious bit of forward planning, even for me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the social committee. Finished stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the GT1 Compressor Section yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done, not carrying anything over on it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, closed off then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the pick and place on two yesterday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same from me on the water booster. Already swapped the filter on the water booster yesterday, so that's not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Nice to have a couple actually off the list for once.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Only an observation: noticed the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Nothing I'm putting forward as new work.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Settled down, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I heard a slight rattle from the turbine one compressor, nothing to action yet. Just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, not turning that into a job on the strength of a passing noise.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Oh, and the shutdown on the Fire Alarm Panel is cancelled now, production need it running. Take that out of the conversation entirely.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, cancelled. Nobody's working to that shutdown.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'm still waiting on parts for the line three, nothing we can do until they arrive. Still blocked, same as yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no parts here to change that position. Not claiming we've magically unblocked it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, that stays blocked. Onto what we can actually agree.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 inlet valve. Top priority please, that one — I'm taking it myself.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, Tomasz has the pressure-drop investigation. No assuming the cause before you've had a look.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, just coming over you — that's separate from the seal replacement, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. I'll replace the seals on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve as well. That's normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it, Tom. Seal replacement at normal priority, not bundled into the top-priority investigation.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Two distinct bits of work; don't merge them because both say GT2.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller today at 2pm? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller today at 2pm. That's fine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: At two, rather than finished before two? Just so we're all hearing the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: At two, yeah. It matters but it's not urgent — no need to turn it into a panic job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Spot on. That's the timing agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the outfeed conveyor, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery. That's still a blocker on the delivery side, not a new chase I'm adding here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Correct. Delivery's unconfirmed; nothing new to report from stores on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: But the existing kit, separate thing: I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the outfeed conveyor at half two. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, Saz. You're taking the jam and sensor check, not promising anything about that delivery?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I can do that work on what's there. Doesn't unblock the supplier delivery.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, two separate issues. That's clearer.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I'll chase the purchase order for the guard switch on two by next Tuesday. Normal priority on that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, Tomasz. You've got the purchase-order chase, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, the chase only. I'm not slipping a fitting job into that sentence.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Next Tuesday for that one, understood. Not this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the 11kV Switchboard by end of day. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Thanks, PR. Urgent sign-off, by end of day, with you.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. Specifically the lock-out tag-out sign-off, not an instruction to energise anything.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Important distinction, that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Grace, can you schedule downtime for the GT1 fuel valve with production? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll schedule downtime for the GT1 fuel valve with production. Low priority, I've got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the scheduling agreement, yeah? Not saying we're stopping it now.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, agreeing the downtime with production. Not calling a stop in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Jamie, can you do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet by the end of the week? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet by the end of the week. Taking that as top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And just to be clear, pre-use still means before use. The end-of-week deadline isn't a free pass.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Absolutely. Not treating the deadline as permission to use anything unchecked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, we're aligned on that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Grace, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1 by the 28th? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1 by the 28th. Understood — drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, Grace, just checking the order against the GT1 fuel valve scheduling. That stays low priority?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It does. The AC1 permit and isolation takes precedence; the GT1 fuel valve scheduling stays low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right. That's deliberate, not two things both secretly first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And my blocked line three parts aren't being confused with the line 3 chiller calibration? Similar names, different conversation.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No confusion here. My line 3 chiller calibration is agreed; your parts-dependent work stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All clear from me. Outfeed conveyor jam and sensors at half two, normal priority. Delivery still separate.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. We done? I can see someone through the office window making very unequal cake slices.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's why I don't trust office catering. Weather's miserable and now the cake allocation's gone wrong.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You'll survive. Thanks, everyone — agreed work as discussed, finished stuff stays closed and the cancelled shutdown stays cancelled. Cheers.
